## Project Overview
Online consultation platform (onlineconsultation) with React frontend and Node.js backend. Recently migrated payment gateway from Razorpay to Airpay. Deployed on VPS at 45.196.196.204. GitHub repo: https://github.com/jitenkr2030/onlineconsultation

## Completed Work
1. Reviewed project structure and architecture
2. Identified areas for improvement
3. Replaced Razorpay with Airpay payment gateway across the codebase:
   - Updated `backend/routes/payments.js` — replaced Razorpay SDK with Airpay API calls
   - Updated `src/pages/PaymentPage.jsx` — replaced Razorpay checkout with Airpay redirect flow
   - Created `src/pages/PaymentReturnPage.jsx` — handles Airpay return redirect
   - Registered `/payment-return/:bookingId` route in `AppRouter.jsx`
   - Updated `index.html` — removed Razorpay checkout.js script tag
   - Updated `backend/.env.example` — replaced Razorpay vars with Airpay vars
   - Updated `.env.example` — replaced Razorpay vars with Airpay vars
   - Updated `KEYS_NEEDED.md` — documented Airpay credentials needed
4. Built frontend dist (`dist_airpay.zip` at `c:/Users/jiten/Documents/Online Consultation/dist_airpay.zip`)
5. Attempted SCP upload to VPS — failed due to Windows password prompt issues
6. Started Python HTTP server on local machine (port 8765) to serve files for VPS wget

## Key Technical Decisions
- Airpay uses a redirect-based payment flow (not SDK-based like Razorpay)
- PaymentReturnPage handles the return URL after Airpay payment
- No git remote configured on VPS — deployment must be done via file transfer
- VPS directory structure: `/var/www/onlinept/` with `backend/`, `frontend/`, `_app/`, `app/`, `data/`, `storage/` subdirectories
- Frontend dist lives in `/var/www/onlinept/frontend/`
- Chose GitHub as transfer mechanism: push dist to GitHub repo, then clone/pull on VPS

## Relevant Files & Code
- `src/pages/PaymentPage.jsx` — Airpay redirect payment initiation
- `src/pages/PaymentReturnPage.jsx` — Airpay return handler (new file)
- `src/routes/AppRouter.jsx` — includes `/payment-return/:bookingId` route
- `index.html` — Razorpay script removed
- `backend/.env.example` — Airpay env vars documented
- `backend/routes/payments.js` — Airpay API integration
- `DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md` — deployment documentation
- `dist_airpay.zip` — built frontend at `c:/Users/jiten/Documents/Online Consultation/dist_airpay.zip`

## Current Status
Attempting to deploy the new Airpay frontend build to VPS. VPS has no git configured. Two approaches tried/in-progress:
1. SCP from Windows — failed (password prompt issues)
2. Python HTTP server started on local port 8765 — next step is to wget from VPS (but VPS needs to reach local machine's IP, which may not work if local machine is behind NAT)
3. GitHub approach proposed: push dist to https://github.com/jitenkr2030/onlineconsultation, then clone on VPS

## Pending Tasks
- Deploy the built frontend dist to `/var/www/onlinept/frontend/` on VPS (45.196.196.204)
  - Option A: Use Python HTTP server (port 8765) — need local machine's public IP for VPS to wget
  - Option B: Push dist folder to GitHub repo and git clone/pull on VPS (preferred — user confirmed GitHub access)
- Verify Airpay payment flow works end-to-end on production
- Ensure backend Airpay env vars are set on VPS
